title: Free-Code Workflow Explorer
summary: JSON source for the single-page workflow explorer. Each component/package is listed once. Each action documents the exact routing path, what payload is passed at every hop, and which packages should be highlighted.

components.label: CLI Router
components.description: Process entry. Reads argv/env, applies fast paths, then chooses REPL, headless, GUI, MCP/native-host, runner, or update routes.

components.label: Ink REPL
components.description: Interactive terminal UI. Owns prompt input, render state, queued commands, scheduled tasks, bridge hooks, notifications, and visible message stream.

components.label: Headless / SDK
components.description: Non-interactive runtime for --print, stream-json, SDK, CCR, control requests, and permission prompts.

components.label: GUI Protocol
components.description: Persistent JSON stdio protocol for Tauri GUI. Converts GUI commands to runtime operations and SDK-style events back to GUI.

components.label: Headless Harness
components.description: Automation/test surface. Runs slash commands and prompts against real commands, tools, app state, and QueryEngine.

components.label: Command Registry
components.description: Builds built-in, skill, plugin, MCP, remote-safe, bridge-safe, and alias command lists.

components.label: Slash Runner
components.description: Parses slash input, resolves command calls, and returns text, prompts, compact results, state changes, or UI actions.

components.label: App State
components.description: Mutable runtime state: permissions, MCP tools/commands/resources, tasks, read-file cache, prompt counters, session ids, compaction flags, GUI/REPL state.

components.label: Tool Pool
components.description: Builds and filters base tools, REPL-only tools, MCP/SDK tools, dynamic tools, deny rules, and permission-sensitive tool lists.

components.label: MCP / Plugins / Skills
components.description: External server, plugin, and skill loading. Contributes tools, commands, resources, hooks, and instructions.

components.label: Hooks
components.description: Session, pre/post compact, stop, permission, and plugin hook execution. Can inject instructions, messages, or user-visible notes.

components.label: QueryEngine
components.description: Conversation facade used by headless, GUI, harness, and SDK paths. Builds context, persists messages, emits SDK events, and calls query().

components.label: query() Loop
components.description: Main model/tool loop. Applies context reducers, streams model output, executes tools, appends tool results, and recurses until turn completion.

components.label: Provider API
components.description: Normalizes messages/tools into provider requests, streams responses, tracks usage, handles retries, fallbacks, and rate-limit metadata.

components.label: Provider Adapters
components.description: Provider descriptors and adapters, including Copilot/OpenAI-compatible request and response translation.

components.label: Tool Execution
components.description: Runs tool_use blocks, permission checks, streaming execution, result normalization, and tool progress events.

components.label: Built-in Tools
components.description: Bash, file read/edit/write, agent, skill, search, notebook, web, synthetic output, and other local tools.

components.label: MCP / SDK Tools
components.description: Tools discovered from MCP or SDK-provided servers. Can be connected, removed, refreshed, and permission-filtered at runtime.

components.label: Compaction
components.description: Manual, partial, auto, micro, snip, cached, and reactive compaction. Rebuilds context with summary, kept messages, attachments, and hook output.

components.label: Persistence / Resume
components.description: Transcript, compact snapshots, metadata, message parentage, session lists, and resume reconstruction.

components.label: Remote Bridge
components.description: Remote control sessions. Moves messages, interrupts, permission callbacks, capacity signals, and bridge-safe commands across local/remote boundary.

components.label: Tasks / Agents
components.description: Background shell tasks, local agents, scheduled prompts, notifications, and task state.

components.label: Output Surfaces
components.description: Final user-visible surfaces: Ink messages, stream-json, SDK events, GUI protocol events, bridge events, and persisted transcripts.

actions.label: Prompt
actions.description: Default interactive user prompt from the terminal REPL.

steps.title: Route to interactive UI
steps.passes: argv/env plus initial cwd, TTY, feature flags, and startup state.
steps.notes: Default mode renders the Ink REPL after early fast paths are skipped.

steps.title: Capture user input
steps.passes: Text blocks, pasted image/file refs, cwd, session id, permissions, queued commands, and app state refs.
steps.notes: REPL keeps visible UI state while AppState carries runtime state used by tools and MCP.

steps.title: Assemble tools
steps.passes: ToolPermissionContext, MCP tools, local base tools, deny rules, REPL mode flags.
steps.notes: Tool list can change between turns when MCP/plugin state changes.

steps.title: Start model loop
steps.passes: Message history, new user message, tool pool, command list, abort controller, hooks, read-file state.
steps.notes: Interactive REPL owns extra rendering state but enters the same query() model/tool loop.

steps.title: Check context budget
steps.passes: Current messages, token estimates, read-file state, tool result budget, compaction policy.
steps.notes: May no-op, microcompact, snip, auto-compact, or later reactive-compact on provider failure.

steps.title: Stream model request
steps.passes: Normalized messages, tool schemas, system prompt, model/provider settings, thinking config, cache controls.
steps.notes: queryModelWithStreaming() yields assistant content and tool_use blocks.

steps.title: Execute requested tools
steps.passes: tool_use id/name/input, assistant message, ToolUseContext, permission callback.
steps.notes: If model emits no tool_use, flow skips tool execution and finishes.

steps.title: Append tool results and recurse
steps.passes: tool_result blocks, attachments, progress, read-file state, output token accounting.
steps.notes: query() repeats model call with appended tool results until assistant turn completes.

steps.title: Render response
steps.passes: Assistant text, tool progress, summaries, notifications, stop reason, usage.
steps.notes: REPL renders streaming updates and final visible transcript.

steps.title: Persist turn
steps.passes: User/assistant/tool_result messages, compact boundaries, metadata, parent UUIDs.
steps.notes: Resume depends on this transcript and compacted state.

actions.label: test prompt
actions.description: Automated prompt through the headless session harness.

steps.title: Prepare harness command set
steps.passes: Test cwd, harness session state, command cache, local command availability.
steps.notes: Harness can run slash commands directly or submit normal prompts.

steps.title: Create isolated AppState
steps.passes: Default app state, test session id, permissions, MCP state, read-file state.
steps.notes: Test harness avoids full Ink rendering but uses real runtime structures.

steps.title: Build test tool pool
steps.passes: Permission context and available MCP/tools for this test session.
steps.notes: Same getTools() path as runtime.

steps.title: Submit prompt
steps.passes: Input string, app state, commands, tools, abort controller, session harness context.
steps.notes: sessionHarness calls QueryEngine.submitMessage() for normal prompts.

steps.title: Run core loop
steps.passes: SDK-compatible message stream, mutable transcript, ToolUseContext.
steps.notes: Harness observes emitted messages instead of rendering REPL UI.

steps.title: Model call
steps.passes: Normalized prompt and tools.
steps.notes: Tests can mock or exercise provider path depending on harness scenario.

steps.title: Collect result
steps.passes: SDK messages, assistant response, tool events, status.
steps.notes: Harness exposes messages through getMessages/readFileState helpers.

actions.label: Slash command
actions.description: Interactive slash command such as /compact, /status, /model, or custom skill commands.

steps.title: Detect command input
steps.passes: Raw slash string, preceding input blocks, image blocks, cwd, command context.
steps.notes: Headless uses a parallel local slash runner, but command semantics are shared.

steps.title: Resolve command
steps.passes: Command name/alias, cwd, remote/bridge availability filters.
steps.notes: Registry can include built-ins, skills, plugins, and MCP-provided commands.

steps.title: Run command call
steps.passes: LocalCommandCall context, current app state, permissions, selected model, command args.
steps.notes: Command may mutate state or return output without model involvement.

steps.title: Optional compaction result
steps.passes: Current messages and custom compact instructions.
steps.notes: /compact and partial compact commands return compacted message sets.

steps.title: Optional prompt expansion
steps.passes: Generated prompt or queued prompt from command result.
steps.notes: Prompt commands re-enter normal model route.

steps.title: Display command result
steps.passes: Text result, UI action, status message, or command error.
steps.notes: Many commands finish here with no provider call.

actions.label: Headless prompt
actions.description: Prompt sent through --print, SDK, or stream-json.

steps.title: Enter non-interactive runtime
steps.passes: Prompt string/stream, outputFormat, verbose flag, permission prompt tool config, cwd.
steps.notes: runHeadless() owns output protocol and SDK control behavior.

steps.title: Initialize dynamic MCP/SDK servers
steps.passes: mcpServers config, clients, discovered tools, commands, resources.
steps.notes: SDK can inject servers at runtime; AppState and dynamic tool state are synchronized.

steps.title: Load commands
steps.passes: cwd and runtime mode.
steps.notes: Slash command input can short-circuit before model.

steps.title: Stream prompt into QueryEngine
steps.passes: Prompt chunks, system context, tool pool, canUseTool handler, structured IO.
steps.notes: runHeadlessStreaming() converts QueryEngine messages to output format.

steps.title: Run model/tool loop
steps.passes: Mutable messages, ToolUseContext, output/event hooks.
steps.notes: Same core as GUI/harness.

steps.title: Emit output
steps.passes: Plain text, JSON result, stream-json event, SDK control response, or error.
steps.notes: Stream-json requires verbose for full event stream.

actions.label: GUI prompt
actions.description: Prompt submitted from the Tauri GUI over the stdio JSON protocol.

steps.title: Start GUI mode
steps.passes: --gui argv, original cwd, stdio transport.
steps.notes: runGuiMode() holds one persistent runtime for the GUI process.

steps.title: Load GUI-visible commands
steps.passes: cwd, command metadata, mode filters.
steps.notes: GUI can submit normal prompts and slash-command actions.

steps.title: Submit GUI message
steps.passes: JSON command payload, text content, runtime app state, tool map.
steps.notes: guiMode tracks tool_use_id to label later tool_result events.

steps.title: Core loop
steps.passes: Messages, tools, permissions, abort signal.
steps.notes: GUI path uses QueryEngine.submitMessage() directly.

steps.title: Convert SDK messages to GUI events
steps.passes: Assistant chunks, tool_use, tool_result, compact boundary, status, errors.
steps.notes: The frontend receives structured protocol events, not terminal rendering.

steps.title: Render in Tauri
steps.passes: GUI protocol events over stdio.
steps.notes: Rust/Tauri side owns final desktop UI display.

actions.label: Tool call
actions.description: Model asks for a tool and result returns to the next model turn.

steps.title: Receive tool_use block
steps.passes: Tool name, tool_use id, JSON input, assistant message id, stream timing.
steps.notes: Streaming execution may start tools before full assistant message is complete.

steps.title: Find matching tool
steps.passes: Tool name/aliases and current permission-filtered tool list.
steps.notes: Tool pool includes built-in and dynamic MCP/SDK tools.

steps.title: Ask permission
steps.passes: Tool metadata, input, permission mode, canUseTool callback, optional custom permission tool.
steps.notes: Deny returns tool_result error; allow proceeds to implementation.

steps.title: Run built-in tool
steps.passes: Typed tool input plus ToolUseContext.
steps.notes: File, shell, agent, skill, and search tools update runtime state as needed.

steps.title: Or call MCP/SDK tool
steps.passes: MCP tool name, server/client handle, input schema payload.
steps.notes: Dynamic tools route through MCP transports and may require server reconnect handling.

steps.title: Normalize result
steps.passes: tool_result content blocks, attachments, progress, error status, token budget metadata.
steps.notes: Result becomes user-role tool_result content for the next model request.

steps.title: Surface progress
steps.passes: Tool progress/status messages, summaries, notifications.
steps.notes: REPL/GUI/headless show progress differently but consume same event concepts.

actions.label: Compaction
actions.description: Manual or automatic context reduction while preserving useful state.

steps.title: Trigger compact
steps.passes: Messages, token estimates, trigger type, custom instructions, cache-safe params.
steps.notes: Can be manual /compact, partial compact, auto-compact, microcompact, snip, or reactive compact.

steps.title: Run pre-compact hooks
steps.passes: Trigger type and custom compact instructions.
steps.notes: Hooks can add display messages or modify compact instructions.

steps.title: Summarize old context
steps.passes: Messages after prior compact boundary, compact prompt, minimal tools for file reads.
steps.notes: Summary call uses model streaming and strips media/reinjected/legacy warning noise.

steps.title: Restore important state
steps.passes: Read-file cache, plan state, agent listing, MCP instruction deltas, invoked skills.
steps.notes: Post-compact attachments keep next turn useful without full old transcript.

steps.title: Write compact snapshot
steps.passes: Boundary marker, summary message, kept messages, attachments, hook results, token metadata.
steps.notes: Resume loads compacted core/visible messages instead of full pre-compact history.

steps.title: Continue with compacted history
steps.passes: buildPostCompactMessages() output.
steps.notes: query() resumes model call using smaller context.

actions.label: MCP tool change
actions.description: Adding, enabling, disabling, or reconnecting MCP/SDK servers during a session.

steps.title: Receive control request
steps.passes: Server config, enable/disable/reconnect action, SDK client info.
steps.notes: Headless/SDK path has the richest dynamic MCP control handling.

steps.title: Update runtime MCP state
steps.passes: Clients, connection status, tools, commands, resources, server names.
steps.notes: AppState is updated so subagents and later turns see new tools.

steps.title: Refresh tool pool
steps.passes: New MCP/SDK tools plus base tools and permission filters.
steps.notes: query() can refresh tools between turns.

steps.title: Refresh commands
steps.passes: MCP commands and command cache invalidation.
steps.notes: New slash commands become available after registry refresh.

steps.title: Expose changed tools to model
steps.passes: Updated tool schemas and deferred tool metadata.
steps.notes: Next model request sees current tool list.

steps.title: Route resume command
steps.passes: Resume args, session selection options, cwd.
steps.notes: Resume can be explicit command or startup flow depending on invocation.

steps.title: Load session metadata
steps.passes: Session id, transcript paths, compact history, saved title/tags.
steps.notes: Compacted snapshots avoid loading full pre-compact history.

steps.title: Rehydrate runtime hints
steps.passes: Messages, compact markers, read-file state hints, prompt counts, mode flags.
steps.notes: AppState and bootstrap state regain enough context for next turn.

steps.title: Render resumed REPL
steps.passes: Visible messages, compact boundaries, session title, notifications.
steps.notes: Interactive resume returns user to terminal UI.

steps.title: Or continue headless
steps.passes: Loaded messages and SDK/headless runtime config.
steps.notes: Non-interactive resume can keep emitting stream-json/SDK events.

actions.label: Bridge event
actions.description: Remote bridge sends prompts, interrupts, permissions, or capacity signals.

steps.title: Receive remote event
steps.passes: Remote session message, interrupt, permission callback, capacity wake, or status update.
steps.notes: Bridge layer translates remote control into local runtime state changes.

steps.title: Filter bridge-safe commands
steps.passes: Current command registry and bridge mode restrictions.
steps.notes: Local-only unsafe commands stay hidden from remote bridge mode.

steps.title: Filter tool availability
steps.passes: Bridge permissions, MCP state, current task context.
steps.notes: Tool calls still pass through normal permission machinery.

steps.title: Forward prompt or control
steps.passes: Prompt text or interrupt/control signal.
steps.notes: Prompt events run through query(); interrupts abort current query/tool work.

steps.title: Return async progress
steps.passes: Task notifications, agent progress, shell state, completion.
steps.notes: Remote side sees progress without owning local task execution.

steps.title: Sync visible state
steps.passes: Messages, status, capacity, permission state.
steps.notes: Bridge and local REPL stay aligned.
